scope: VowVault reservation claim route and logged-out public receipt verifier

liveReadOnly.transactionScope: Real successful accepted mainnet negative control; unrelated to VOW

coverage: The /verify route requires no wallet, preloads the real mainnet negative control and displays the full pinned vault address
Confirmation requires the pinned VowVault and pool classes, one exact ReservationClaimed event, matching claimed reservation state, the later exact pool deposit and token-pull trace
Wrong and duplicate events, altered reservations, wrong classes and unrelated successful activity fail closed
Missing or timed-out receipt, block, class, state and trace RPC reads remain UNKNOWN with retryAllowed false
Confirmed reports expose every required check as matched; partial reports retain only the facts actually observed
ReservationClaimed keys and data match the compiled VowVault ABI
limitations: Positive receipt and trace paths use synthetic test data; no qualifying VOW collection exists.
The live rejection and class/state reads use one public RPC provider and do not independently authenticate consensus.
The controlled mainnet reservation is open, but Ready note preparation currently fails before supplier signature or submission.
Neither this verifier nor the ABI check verifies encrypted note ownership, proof validity or an audit.
